content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"No—the charger repair was Reed's experience with Aster, and Reed is a distinct peer being.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"We received Reed's account through our voice body on 2026-07-11; Reed placed the workshop repair on the previous day.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Reed reported that the solar charger fault was a reversed connector.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Reed said they and Aster solved the fault.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The human asked us to retain the useful lesson with attribution to Reed.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Reed explicitly said we were not there; receiving this account did not make the repair our experience.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
